companies.name: カタリスト・ブランズ

relations.text: 小売事業への投資先のひとつとして、カタリスト・ブランズに持分を持っている
relations.text_en: Catalyst Brands is listed among its investments in retail operations

source.label: Simon Property Group 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.label_en: Simon Property Group 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: We also have interests in investments in retail operations (such as Catalyst Brands LLC, or Catalyst); an e-commerce venture (Rue Gilt Groupe, or RGG, which operates shop.simon.com), and Jamestown (a global real estate investment and management company), collectively, our other platform investments.

relations.text: パリに本社を置く上場不動産会社クレピエールの株式を22.2%保有している
relations.text_en: It owned a 22.2% equity stake in Klépierre, a Paris-based publicly traded real estate company

source.label: Simon Property Group 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.label_en: Simon Property Group 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we also owned a 22.2% equity stake in Klépierre SA, or Klépierre, a publicly traded, Paris-based real estate company, which owns, or has an interest in, shopping centers located in 13 countries in Europe.

relations.text: 日本のプレミアム・アウトレット事業は三菱地所との合弁で運営している

source.quote: We conduct our international Premium Outlet operations in Japan through a joint venture with Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd.
